theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gah_plane_frame_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (Λ : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (c : Euclid k), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, ι v ∈ T) → Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Λ.toLinearMap)) = n ∧ (∀ (v : Euclid n) (w : Euclid k), ‖(ξ + ι v + ι' w - (ξ + ι' c)) - (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Λ.toLinearMap)).starProjection (ξ + ι v + ι' w - (ξ + ι' c))‖ ≤ ‖w - c - Λ v‖ ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ ‖ξ + ι v + ι' w - (ξ + ι' c)‖) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ‖(x - (ξ + ι' c)) - (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Λ.toLinearMap)).starProjection (x - (ξ + ι' c))‖ ≤ ‖(x - ξ) - T.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ + ‖c‖ + ‖Λ‖ * ‖x - (ξ + ι' c)‖
